## History

Oliver Sloane was among the young villagers affected when a mix-up with paint order numbers caused the local village hall to be painted a glaring blue instead of green, an incident that ultimately rallied the town behind the youth. Later, during a meeting of the Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), he was present when [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md) revealed that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) intended to rent his fence space for patent-medicine advertisements.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P25](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0025), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032), [v2 IX A Question of Color P40](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0040), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P18](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0018), +2 more_
